about: The spine: eighteen jobs every language must do. Each job is one lesson in every course, with the same title, so lesson N is the same job in all thirteen. What differs between languages is the strategy. A grid-<language>.json file fills one cell per job. Written by Claude with Ben on 13 November 2026, from Development/EarthFluentGrammar.md.

strategies.ending: The word itself changes, usually at its end.
strategies.helper word: A separate word does the job, and the other words stay as they were.
strategies.particle: A small marker with no meaning of its own is added, after a word or at the end of the sentence.
strategies.word order: The words stay the same and their order does the job.
strategies.tone: The voice does the job, and writing shows it with punctuation.
strategies.nothing: The language does not mark this at all. Still a lesson, a short one: what to stop looking for.

row.foreign: What the learner learns. With english, this is the lesson's pair.
row.mark: The parts of foreign that do the job. Each is an exact piece of the foreign text. The lesson board lights these up.
row.from: The number of an earlier row in the same cell that this row is built from: the statement behind the question, the yes behind the no. The board shows that row first, then the change.
row.base: The dictionary form of the word that changes, in the foreign language.
row.features: What this form says: who (i, you, she, we, you-all, they), when (now, before, later), and so on.

jobs.name: Who Is Doing It
jobs.asks: How do I say who is doing it?

jobs.name: Now, Before, and Later
jobs.asks: How do I say when it happens?

jobs.name: Still Going or Finished
jobs.asks: How do I say it is going on right now, or that it is done?

jobs.name: Telling Someone to Do It
jobs.asks: How do I tell or ask someone to do it?

jobs.name: More Than One
jobs.asks: How do I say there is more than one?

jobs.name: The and A
jobs.asks: How do I say the, and a?

jobs.name: Mine and Yours
jobs.asks: How do I say whose it is?

jobs.name: This and That
jobs.asks: How do I point at this one, or that one?

jobs.name: Counting
jobs.asks: How do I say how many?

jobs.name: How Polite
jobs.asks: How do I speak to a friend, and to a stranger?

jobs.name: Saying No
jobs.asks: How do I say it is not so?

jobs.name: Asking a Question
jobs.asks: How do I ask a question with a yes or a no for an answer?

jobs.name: Who, What, and Where
jobs.asks: How do I ask who, what, or where?

jobs.name: Want To, Can, and Must
jobs.asks: How do I say I want to, I can, or I must?

jobs.name: Describing a Thing
jobs.asks: How do I say what a thing is like?

jobs.name: Where It Is
jobs.asks: How do I say where something is?

jobs.name: More and Most
jobs.asks: How do I say more, and the most?

jobs.name: And, But, and Because
jobs.asks: How do I join two things, or two sentences?
